tools.name: find_practitioners
tools.description: Search the directory of allergists offering ILIT. Give a zip code, a city, "City, ST", a state name or code, or coordinates. Results come nearest first with the distance in miles; a 50-mile radius splits "within" from "further", but people travel far for ILIT, so always show the closest ones even wh

tools.name: get_practitioner
tools.description: One listing in full: practitioner and certification, address, phone, website, hours, allergens, availability, protocol, cost, other offices of the same clinic, and which requests the listing accepts. Identify it by id, slug, URL, or the clinic or practitioner name.

tools.name: list_practices
tools.description: Every clinic in the directory with its practitioner and offices (id, city, state, phone, URL). Optional state filter.

tools.name: list_allergens
tools.description: The allergens the directory tracks, with how many offices treat each with ILIT.

tools.name: get_facts
tools.description: What the Society is, counts (offices, practitioners, states, allergens, articles), how finding and requests work, what the site does not do, and how to get in touch.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Plain answers from the Society’s question pages: what ILIT is, how it works, evidence and approval, cost and insurance, finding a practitioner, consultations and appointments, listing criteria. Give a question or keywords; without a query, returns the topics.

tools.name: search_journal
tools.description: Search the Journal (articles for patients and practitioners) by keywords or topic; returns title, date, summary, key points and URL.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: A Journal article’s full text, by slug, id, URL or title.

tools.name: request_consultation
tools.description: Send a consultation request (a first conversation, at the practice or over Zoom) to a listing that offers consultations. The practice contacts the person within two business days to confirm a time; nothing is booked by the site. Requires the person’s name, phone, email and consent=true.

tools.name: request_appointment
tools.description: For a person who has decided to start ILIT: send an appointment request to a listing that accepts them. The practice contacts the person within two business days to confirm dates; nothing is booked by the site. Requires name, phone, email and consent=true.

tools.name: apply_for_listing
tools.description: For an allergist or immunologist offering ILIT: submit a listing application. The Society checks board certification against the ABAI register and creates the listing by hand; nothing is published automatically. Requires confirm_accurate=true and confirm_terms=true.

tools.name: how_to_get_in_touch
tools.description: How to reach the Society (email), how a practice gets listed, and how a person reaches a practice (requests through the site, or the listing’s phone and website).

tools.name: what_the_site_does_not_do
tools.description: The limits: no booking, no medical advice, no medical records, no ranking, no prices of its own, and that ILIT is off-label in the US.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_practitioner, list_practices, search_journal, get_article, how_to_get_in_touch · Private data: request_consultation, request_appointment, what_the_site_does_not_do · Public sink: request_consultation, request_appointment, apply_for_listing, how_to_get_in_touch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_practitioner, list_practices, search_journal, get_article, how_to_get_in_touch · Private data: request_consultation, request_appointment, what_the_site_does_not_do · Public sink: request_consultation, request_appointment, apply_for_listing, how_to_get_in_touch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
